correctness.rationale: For zero diagonal G and arbitrary directed nonnegative extended weights, powering each finite forward pair by p gives acyclic index weights A_ij. Every ordered subsequence has weight at most the maximal 0-to-n path D_n, and because A>=0 can extend without lowering the sum. D_j=max_{i<j}(D_i+A_ij) is nondecreasing; intervals r_j^p=D_j-D_(j-1) dominate every A_ij by telescoping and total exactly D_n. Conversely every Cho interval certificate upper bounds all disjoint subsequence sums, proving exact grades. Separate max-monoid p=infinity argument, infinity scale/edge cases and degree zero are sound. Independently enumerated 909 finite upper-triangular matrices; the published 4-vertex example has D=(0,1,10,16), certificate (1,3,sqrt6), all pair bounds satisfied at radius 4. Exhaustive finite checks corroborate the unrestricted proof.
